integrity: Finite exhaustive checker is reproducible from the embedded Python source; the universal monotone valuation implication is proved analytically. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Theorem classifies triples of nonempty MMS-attaining partitions for three agents and five goods, not all valuations. A forbidden partition triple is necessary but need not suffice for an arbitrary monotone valuation profile. The sharp nonexistence construction is already implied by Feige (2026); only the exhaustive uniqueness and structural classification are advanced here. Unindexed prior combinatorial lemmas may overlap.
title: Unique five-good obstruction to maximin-share allocation for three agents
